desc:
Welcome to Skytopia, the future of Topia City!

🏢 Own different styles of apartments in the futuristic city!
🚔 Experience future services including banking, law enforcement, medical treatment, and more!
🚀 Take futuristic transportation including air ships and flying cars!
🎭 RP! Choose your own roles and jobs to roleplay!

Please thumbs-up 👍 and favorite ⭐ if you enjoy the game.
